description: Catalog of background music tracks: their CRI cue-sheet/row names, gallery labels, track length, and whether the music is unlocked from the start.

Id.simple: Row key / BGM ID used by game phases and the sequencer.
Id.technical: FName primary key. Game phases look it up from request/story-chapter/mission-wave IDs; the gallery uses it to test the user's heard-BGM set; DTM_CollectBattleBgmRows filters rows by an case-insensitive 'BATTLE' substring and returns this Id to random battle selection. The sequencer's PlayBgm resolves a row then forwards Row->Id to SoundManager.PlayBgm, which uses it as the BGM loader/cue-sheet name. Export spells it ID.

CueSheetName.simple: CRI Atom cue sheet to play for the track.
CueSheetName.technical: FString, default empty (inline constructor). Battle and level-sequencer/debug paths construct an FName from this string and pass it to PlayBgm; an empty string becomes an empty FName. BattleBase/MissionBase return it as the battle BGM name, falling back to an empty name (or literal BGM_BATTLE_01 when no row exists). Exported rows generally repeat the row ID, but the field is independent and must be read from the row.

Id_SoundText.simple: Localized text ID shown as the track title in the sound collection.
Id_SoundText.technical: FName. UGameCollectionSoundListItem::GetTitleTextId returns this row value; the collection item widget displays it for unlocked entries and a locked placeholder for unheard music. It is also used as the display string for free-battle BGM option boxes, where an extra Random option is appended and SetUseTextId is enabled.

Duration.technical: float, default 0.0f. The credit scroll uses the BGM_DEMO_07 row minus 3.5 s and the BGM_DEMO_01 row directly as ease durations. The collection slider sets its maximum to Duration, substituting 1.0f when abs(Duration) <= UE_SMALL_NUMBER. Exported values are whole-number seconds, but the field itself is a float.

bInitialReleaseEnabled.simple: Whether the track is unlocked before the player has heard it.
bInitialReleaseEnabled.technical: bool, default false. At startup, every row with this flag true is inserted into GameManager.UserInfo.StudioBgmNames_BE8; the collection widget's unlock state is then determined by membership in that same set. In the exported table only BGM_DEMO_10 is true, so the others start locked unless encountered in play.

notes: Loaded as a 'DataTable' primary asset named BgmDataTable into DTM.BgmDataTables (+0x720); Status_FindBgmRow walks tables in order and, with bCheckNone=true, rejects None IDs.

Two playback paths exist and must not be conflated: battle/menu phases pass row.CueSheetName to SoundManager.PlayBgm, while the sequencer sound module resolves a row by SoundId and passes row.Id. Both ultimately reach the BGM loader in AGameSoundManager::PlayBgm.
DTM_CollectBattleBgmRows selects rows whose Id contains BATTLE case-insensitively from the start of the string; this is a naming convention, not a dedicated flag.
The credit widget reads BGM_DEMO_07 without a null check, so a missing row would crash; no defensive fallback was observed there.
Source is reconstructed retail code; exported assets are partial. Only 28 BGM rows are present in the companion export, so retail completeness and all Blueprint references cannot be asserted.

usages.detail: Requests BgmDataTable as a primary asset.
Collects rows whose Id contains BATTLE for random battle BGM selection.
Looks up the requested battle BGM and returns CueSheetName.
Falls back from wave BGM to request BGM and returns CueSheetName.
Sequencer PlayBgm resolves the row and plays using Row.Id.
Builds the sound-collection list from all Bgm rows.
Grants initially enabled BGMs at startup.
Uses Duration of fixed BGM IDs to drive the credit scroll.
